failedRegistration.clockLimit: Application spans and platform wall readings have different boundaries. Do not subtract across them.
failedRegistration.correlation: Browser ceremony ID matches B preparation metadata. Session bytes match the attempt key. Object identity and request interval bridge that attempt to the Router trace.
failedRegistration.cause: Unresolved. Current data locates protocol waiting without identifying the blocked operation.

failureLedger.observation: Generated build stamps contained terminal color escapes.
failureLedger.resolution: Regenerated all five release role builds with FORCE_COLOR=0. No generated stamp was hand-edited.

failureLedger.observation: Google test identity token missing from the test process before registration.
failureLedger.resolution: Refreshed the existing configured test identity and supplied it to the isolated rerun. The existing lifecycle case passed.

failureLedger.observation: Registration ended with router_execution_burned before any transaction signature.
failureLedger.repair: No production change. Retain the failure outside successful-signing percentiles.

failureLedger.observation: Read-only deployment metadata returned HTTP 500 after the transaction cohort.
failureLedger.resolution: The separate recheck matched all 14 original backend deployment IDs. Remaining unstarted cohorts ran separately.

limitations: These cohorts are a current baseline, not a matched optimization comparison.
Primary hosted assets were local HTTPS. The October 21 comparison served its iframe remotely.
Post-passkey timing uses observed console-event completion timestamps. Console delivery can add overhead.
Automated confirmation subtraction is diagnostic and does not measure human wait.
Local chain RPC is stubbed. Hosted transaction RPC uses the real network.
First hosted transaction signing can include implicit-account funding. Its SDK duration is reported separately.
Runtime cold state and competing hosted traffic were not controlled. Existing local background activity was not stopped.
The local Email OTP result is one correctness journey, not a latency distribution.
Warm message, dedicated step-up latency, bounded NEAR concurrency, mobile, and other geographic cohorts remain incomplete.
Twenty hosted message samples cannot establish p99 or universal acceptance.
Raw protected tails contain broader traffic. Use request or protocol identities before attributing role records.
